# glasses.bitmap

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Draw a bitmap at position x, y.

```lua
glasses.bitmap(x, y, bitmap)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | unsigned | yes | bitmap horizontal position |
| `y` | unsigned | yes | bitmap vertical position |
| `bitmap` | unsigned | yes | bitmap ID |

## Returns

Nothing.

- [active-look](../../examples/official/active-look.md)
